children: On September 10, European patent licensing firm Tulip Licensing Ltd launched Tulip Imaging, a new patent licensing program for image and visual information processing. OPPO is one of the first four licensors, alongside Huawei, Canon and Sony, according to Jiemian News. The program covers more than 125,000 patents accumulated over decades of research and innovation by the four companies.

title: Tulip Licensing Launches Tulip Imaging Patent Program With OPPO, Huawei, Canon and Sony
